text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo, time for food! I've been
looking forward
to this since this
morning! ♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I got a special food ticket for
helping out
at the cafeteria the other
day.
choice_data_list: You seem to be in quite a good moo...
You seem to be in pretty good spir...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
They're offering two different items, and
I can use
this ticket to redeem whichever
I want.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it's a rare opportunity! I can't
wait to see
what they're serving!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Special menu, special menu...
Oh!
There it is! All the way down in the
corner.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Okay, the first one is called... "Lovely
Angel ☆"?!
Er... "Heartful Jiggly-Wiggly
Pudding"...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-who the heck comes up with this
stuff?! It
looks tasty, sure, but there's no
way I can order
that out loud!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Okay, what's the other one called?
"Hellfire
Inferno Tartarus Curry"?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That sounds dangerously spicy! And look
what's written underneath. "Fewer than
five people have
ever managed to finish
this meal." Oh man!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What a name. It'd be awesome to get into the hall of fame as one of the only people who actually managed to eat it... but I'm guessing it's real spicy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then again, that L-Lovely Angel
Pudding thing
sounds good too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh! Which one do I choose?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh! Which one do I choose?!
choice_data_list: Let's push past this hellish spici...
In life, sometimes a little sweetn...
In life, sometimes a little sweetn...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Sh-should I really?!
choice_data_list: Let's push past this hellish spici...
In life, sometimes a little sweetn...
In life, sometimes a little sweetn...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What? No! I'm not scared or anything!
These are
happy quivers! All right, I'll
take on the curry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka valiantly takes on the challenge
of eating
the face-melting curry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaah! It's s-so hot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
D-dammit! My vision's all blurry from the
tears...
I-I don't know if I can actually do
this!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? What are you giving me? Oh,
milk! That's
right, they say milk's better
than water for spicy
food!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! This'll definitely keep
my engine
from overheating! Now I can
finish this!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Raaah! I'm back in business, baby! Time
to polish
off this curry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka sweats bullets as she struggles
through her
meal, but manages to clean
her plate!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew! My mouth's still burning, but at
least now I'll be forever acknowledged
as one of the victors
who conquered this
curry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But of course, I couldn't have done it
without
your support, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I ever find myself in a pinch,
I'm gonna be
counting on you to help me out, just
like you did
today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Graaah! I don't care how spicy this curry
is, if I eat
it all before it starts burning,
this'll be a piece
of—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, what? Th-this is... sp-SP-SPICYYY!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... My mouth's on fire! I've really
done it
this time...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man... I couldn't even manage to eat half
of it...
That's so not cool...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... Still, it's pretty pathetic that
the spice
level kept me from even
finishing it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! If I ever get another chance, I'm
gonna devour every last bite! I'll get you
next time,
Hellfire Inferno Tartarus
Curry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You know what? You're right.
Forcing
myself to eat the curry just to
look cool would
actually be kinda lame.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, it's not like I specifically want to eat that pudding or anything. I just haven't had anything sweet in a while.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello there, Vodka! What will you
be having
today?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um, can I get the item written in the
bottom
corner, please?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Hm? Which one's that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Th-the, uh... You know... Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nnngh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C-can I please have th-the Lovely
Angel ☆
Heartful Jiggly-Wiggly
Pudding?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, that was so embarrassing! You
don't see Scarlet around here, do you?
I'll never hear the
end of it if she heard
me asking for that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was so excited to use that
ticket...
I had no
idea it was a ticket to shame...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well... Yeah, I guess. It was about
as tasty
as its name was ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So, yeah... I guess it was pretty good.
